semiconductor_relevance: High — GST provides essential environmental protection equipment and temperature control systems specifically for the semiconductor industry.
summary: Global Standard Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in environmental protection equipment and temperature control systems tailored for the semiconductor and high-end manufacturing sectors. Their product offerings include advanced scrubbers and chillers, which are critical for maintaining optimal operational conditions in wafer fabrication.
capabilities: Process chillers for various application scenarios

regional_presence.Korea: GST is based in Korea and has been listed on the KOSDAQ market since February 2006.
